subject: [PATCH v2 02/17] selftests/mm: scale khugepaged's collapse wait with the PMD size

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch adjusts the wait time for khugepaged's collapse operation to scale with the PMD size. The original three-second wait is kept as a floor, and an additional second is added per 128M of memory being collapsed. This change aims to prevent false timeouts in cases where the collapse takes longer due to larger PMDs, while still allowing real failures to be reported within a reasonable time frame.
